tools.name: search-knowledge-base
tools.description: Searches approved support articles by keyword. Use this when answering product or troubleshooting questions. Example: search for password reset.

searchText.description: Customer question or troubleshooting phrase to search for, minimum length 3 characters and maximum length 200 characters.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching articles to return, minimum 1 and maximum 10.

outputSchema.description: Ranked support articles relevant to the query.

articles.description: Matching support articles ordered by relevance.

tools.name: create-support-ticket
tools.description: Creates a support ticket after troubleshooting fails. Use this when the user needs human follow-up. Example: create a ticket for an urgent outage. Call search-knowledge-base first.

customerId.description: Internal customer identifier from the CRM, maximum 64 characters, valid format pattern uses letters, numbers, underscore, or hyphen.

priority.description: Support urgency level, max 10 characters. Must be one of: low, normal, high, urgent.

summary.description: One-sentence issue summary for the support queue, minimum length 10 characters and maximum length 160 characters.

troubleshootingNotes.description: Troubleshooting message and relevant article links, minimum length 20 characters and maximum length 2000 characters.

createdAt.description: Ticket creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
